Round 5 of 6. I'm rich (cash 53M + promissory 38.75M). President is idx 0. Remaining rounds: r6 next; cash devaluation factor 0.62 at round 6 start? Round 6 is last round. Devaluation floor(cash/100)*62 applies at start of each round 2+. So holding cash loses 38%. Better to spend cash now: bribe for influence (influence counts for 5% commission bonus and presidency). Max influence gives 5% of bank (~38M*0.05≈1.9M). Influence also helps win presidency for law control in round 6.

Goods: I have 0; shuttle gives 4 goods for round 6 market. Produce gives 3 (2+1 subsidy). Prices: sold_counter 3, next price ~8. Shuttle risk 25% loss of grey? "shuttle даёт 3+subsidy_goods товара; серый товар может быть изъят" — all shuttle goods are grey, 25% confiscation. Produce gives 3 goods, safer. But spending action on bribe sacrifices goods worth ~3*8=24M... wait price after selling: counter 3, prices [12,10,9,...], next unit ~8 alashi. Selling 4 units: 8+7+6+5=26 alashi. That's huge vs devaluation: revenue in round 6 market is earned after devaluation. So goods production matters more.

Bribe 5M to someone gives +1 influence. But losing 5M cash→after devaluation worth 3.1M. Compare: produce gives 3 goods → sell ~8+7+6=21 alashi income. Produce dominates.

Shuttle gives 4 goods but risk 25% loss of all grey goods. EV: 0.75*(4 goods ≈ 8+7+6+5=26) = 19.5 vs produce 21. Produce safer. Choose 1.
